answer: Histories are stored in grove, checked in opal, and bridge shows each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases as the record follows the key, which means laundering reputation through new keys does not work. Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 8 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. A farm of 1061 identities would post 1264 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
